data.name: Ensign
data.long_meaning: In ancient cultures, an ensign was a military flag bearer. This name symbolizes leadership, courage, and protection. It is derived from the Greek word 'ensignon', meaning 'standard-bearer'.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ensign" holds a rich historical and cultural significance due to its origins as a military term. It represents the concept of leadership, embodying the qualities of bravery, courage, and determination. The ensign carried the flag, usually bearing the emblem of the regiment or military unit, while leading troops into battle. This name signifies the spirit of leading others, especially during challenging times, and making a difference in the world.
data.spiritual_significance: Biblically, the ensign refers to a standard brought forth to represent God. In Isaiah 11:12, the prophet states, "And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth." This verse highlights that the ensign acts as a symbol of unity, hope, and God's promise to gather his people. Symbolically, the Christian name "Ensign" can be interpreted as a call to be a beacon of faith, solidarity, and a witness to God's presence in the world.
